root_cause: ChatOrchestrator builds ONE LLMService at __init__ with the tenant alone (the known J2 carry-forward); its tenant-to-workspace resolution froze at construction. T2's comparison answered CORRECTLY via the read-only fallback but resolved unconfirmed for the same reason (no planner -> no comparison evidence).
